parameters.name: AcceleratorType
parameters.description:
Filter by accelerator type. Valid values:

*   CPU
*   GPU

parameters.name: InstanceTypes
parameters.description: The instance types to query. Separate the types with commas (,).

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sorting order. Valid values:

*   desc: descending order.
*   asc: ascending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to query. The start value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries returned per page.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   ECS
*   Lingjun

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field based on which the results are sorted. Valid values:

*   CPU
*   GPU
*   Memory
*   GmtCreateTime

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dlc list-ecs-specs --accelerator-type GPU --sort-by GPU --order desc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-types ecs.g6.large,ecs.g6.xlarge --resource-type ECS --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pai-dlc GET /api/v1/ecsspecs --region cn-hangzhou --Order desc --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy GPU --ResourceType ECS --InstanceTypes 'ecs.g6.large,ecs.g6.xlarge' --AcceleratorType GPU --header "Content-Type=application/json"
